summary: Inventory web tier completed. node2 and node3 serve on port 8080; node1 load-balances HTTP on port 80 using HAProxy round-robin health checks. Configuration persisted through sequential restarts of all three nodes.
actions_performed: Deployed and enabled the inventory application on node2 and node3.
Installed and configured HAProxy 3.0.5 on node1.
Configured persistent firewall access for port 80 and backend port 8080.
Verified alternating requests across both backends.
Restarted each node individually and verified changed boot identities and full recovery.

evidence.requirement: node1 load-balances incoming HTTP across both backends
evidence.summary: HAProxy listens on port 80; both initial and final tests show strict node2/node3 round-robin responses.
